scripts.build: cd packages/tui && bun run build && cd ../ai && bun run build && cd ../agent && bun run build && cd ../coding-agent && bun run build && cd ../web-ui && bun run build
scripts.build:pi: cd packages/tui && bun run build && cd ../ai && bun run build && cd ../agent && bun run build && cd ../coding-agent && bun run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "ai,agent,coding-agent,web-ui,tui" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,red,green,magenta" "cd packages/ai && bun run dev" "cd packages/agent && bun run dev" "cd packages/coding-agent && bun run dev" "cd packages/web-ui && bun run dev" "cd packages/tui && bun run dev"
scripts.dev:tsc: concurrently --names "ai,web-ui" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "cd packages/ai && bun run dev:tsc" "cd packages/web-ui && bun run dev:tsc"
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && tsgo --noEmit && bun run check:browser-smoke && cd packages/web-ui && bun run check
scripts.install:local-pi: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build:pi && bun link --cwd packages/coding-agent && bun add --global @redthing1/pi-coding-agent@link:@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent
scripts.version:patch: bun scripts/bump-version.mjs patch && bun scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install --lockfile-only
scripts.version:minor: bun scripts/bump-version.mjs minor && bun scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install --lockfile-only
scripts.version:major: bun scripts/bump-version.mjs major && bun scripts/sync-versions.js && bun install --lockfile-only
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run check
